title: Prime number
summary: A positive integer greater than 1 with no positive divisors other than 1 and itself.

context.formal_system: positive integers with ordinary multiplication and divisibility

content.human: A prime cannot be factored into two smaller positive integers greater than 1.
content.exact: For p in Z with p>1, p is prime iff for every positive integer d, d divides p implies d=1 or d=p.
content.example: 7 is prime. 12 is not prime because 3 divides 12 and 3 is neither 1 nor 12.
content.caveat: This seed record uses the standard positive-integer definition; “prime elements” in general rings require separate contextual definitions.

verification.method: Definition checked for internal consistency; not yet linked to an external formal proof artifact.
